title: Saronic announcement strip
description: A sonar-lime strip above the header: mono capital caption, a dimmer news line clipped at the window edge on phones, a small ink-tinted button and a close X at the far right. 48px tall on phones, 64px on desktop; closing removes it.
notes: needs JavaScript for the close button
sits above saronic-header; the hero's `belowBar` keeps the hero ending at the window bottom
